floors.description: Stolen meadowland rolls out under the tower's floodlights. Hedgerows still stand in their old lines, fencing fields no farmer will cut again. Somewhere out in the grass, something is moving.

monsters.name: Grey wolf
monsters.lore: Farm dogs once kept them past the fences. The dogs are gone; the wolves remember the gap in the third hedge.

monsters.name: Feral boar
monsters.lore: Sty stock gone wild in two generations. It charges first and decides why later.

monsters.name: Hedgerow rat
monsters.lore: Granary doors stood open the night the farms fell. What ate its fill in the dark kept growing.

monsters.name: The last pack
monsters.lore: The steading's sheepdogs, feral now, hunting in a silent ring. One of them still turns its head at a whistle.

monsters.name: Goblin straggler
monsters.lore: Marched down from the warrens to hold the low gate, then left behind sick when the war-band climbed on. Nobody pays its wage.

monsters.name: Hedge-wight
monsters.lore: Spilled aether soaked into a rotten stile. Nothing living was ever in it.

floors.description: A slab of mountainside ends at a mine-mouth still weeping orange iron-water. Ore-carts sit loaded on rails that run off the cut edge into open air. Somewhere down the dark drift, water is moving.

monsters.name: Rust hound
monsters.lore: Iron-scale coats it and its jaws lock half-open. The packs still run the rails, hauling nothing.

monsters.name: Cave cricket
monsters.lore: Fist-sized now, it springs man-high and strips leather and lamp-wick down to nothing.

monsters.name: Shellback tortoise
monsters.lore: Grown door-broad in the flooded drift, shell crusted to rust-plate. It holds the narrow ways like a gate.

monsters.name: Kobold digger
monsters.lore: First-taken from the warrens far below and set to cut the giants' seams. The collar does the deciding.

monsters.name: Red Orc outrider
monsters.lore: A pressed veteran of Skarn's warcamp, sent down to keep the diggers digging. No one pays the wage it kills for.

monsters.name: The Seep
monsters.lore: Spilled aether pooled in the rust-water. It was never alive; it only moves.

floors.description: A pasture taken mid-flood and never drained — grey water to the horizon, hedge-tops and half-drowned fences breaking the surface. Hay-ricks stand as islands. Somewhere a sluice still turns, keeping the wrong things wet.

monsters.name: Marsh wolf
monsters.lore: Web-footed now, wading the channels between the ricks. It swims better than you pole.

monsters.name: Marsh adder
monsters.lore: Fever-bold now, striking from the reed at anything warm.

monsters.name: Mire boar
monsters.lore: Mud-armored to the eyes, it beds in the reed and bursts out at a punt's shadow.

monsters.name: Fence-wire pike
monsters.lore: Grown long through the drowned fence-wire until steel and muscle are one barbed length.

monsters.name: Drowned lantern
monsters.lore: A trapper's lamp lost in the flood, aether soaked into the dead flame. It calls punts onto the black reed.

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

floors.description: An elf-wood whose trees once lit themselves, snuffed in a single night. The sap runs dark, the glimmer-moss is ash-grey, and past the first branches the floodlights fail. Whatever moves in there moves by sound.

monsters.name: Pale stag
monsters.lore: Colorless and blind-white, it walks the dark by sound and gores at light.

monsters.name: Dusk-hare
monsters.lore: Fever-fast and fearless, it bolts from the dark straight at the eyes.

monsters.name: Lamp newt
monsters.lore: It slept in lamplight once. Hand-span and starving now, it smothers any flame.

monsters.name: Wick-owl
monsters.lore: Silent and over-large now, hunting warmth instead of watching flames.

monsters.name: The lamp-eater
monsters.lore: The black lichen that drinks light, gathered into a slow crawling shape. Nothing living is in it.

monsters.name: Glade-wight
monsters.lore: A dead lamp-tree, aether pooled in its rot. It walks with a cold false glow.

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Gallery after gallery runs down into dead-black water. The great pumps that held it back are drowned with the deep they kept dry, and drowned gear hangs on drowned pegs. The flat water goes down further than any lamp will show.

monsters.name: Blind cave-fish
monsters.lore: Massed and biting, they boil the surface wherever warmth touches it.

monsters.name: Sump lamprey
monsters.lore: Fever-long now, it strikes up from the flat black at a lamp's reflection.

monsters.name: Drift courser
monsters.lore: It still runs the dry drifts end to end, fever-fast, coursing anything that carries a light.

monsters.name: Sump-crawler
monsters.lore: Soft-skinned once. Shield-backed and many-legged now, it scuttles the drowned floors underfoot.

monsters.name: Bilge kobold
monsters.lore: First-taken from the warrens and set to bail the deep by hand. The collar keeps it at it.

monsters.name: Drowned-miner husk
monsters.lore: A drift-crew's lost lamp and gear, aether pooled in the flood over them. It wades in the shape of a working man.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The floodlights fail at the last terrace and the true dark begins — a cavern country floored a thousand years deep in guano, silk in the high corners, cold that has never known a season. Bring your own light or bring nothing.

monsters.name: Grave-rat
monsters.lore: Drawn to warm breath even then. Palm-broad now, it powders the eyes with grave-dust.

monsters.name: Guano vole
monsters.lore: Bloated and bold, it gnaws boots, rope, and whatever the rope holds.

monsters.name: Cave broodling
monsters.lore: Dog-sized and hunting in threads — the first of many broods above.

monsters.name: Sentinel spider
monsters.lore: Fever-quick now, it drops on a shielded lamp from the unseen roof.

monsters.name: Vault boar
monsters.lore: Blind and guano-crusted, it plugs the narrow ways and gives you only its front. The one road on is through.

monsters.name: Silk-wrapped husk
monsters.lore: A delver lost to the silk, aether pooled in the bundle. It mimics a caught man's voice.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

floors.description: Mile on mile of planted rows gone to rot, the ground ankle-deep in windfall fermenting under the floodlights. The air is thick, sweet, and drunk; wasps hang in it like sparks. Nine generations pruned these trees. Nobody will pick them.

monsters.name: Orchard wolf
monsters.lore: It hunts the rows in silent packs, drunk-bold on the haze.

monsters.name: Cider-mad boar
monsters.lore: Reeling, furious, and fearless on fermented mush.

monsters.name: Mouse-tide
monsters.lore: The wrongness would not let one small thing stay one. It follows warmth and sweat as a hundred now.

monsters.name: Windfall dormouse
monsters.lore: Bloated on rot, reeling in drunk spirals, going for the eyes.

monsters.name: Orchard hare
monsters.lore: Fever-swift, bolting between the rows into shins and ankles.

monsters.name: Windfall haunt
monsters.lore: A presser drowned in a vat, aether soaked into the black cider. It offers a cup.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Grey ash dunes to the horizon — the burned frontier no crown ever wanted. The wind moves the ash in slow sheets, jackals work the dune-shadows, and the first hot floor of the climb bakes under floodlights that only add glare. Water here is a secret.

monsters.name: Ashline jackal
monsters.lore: Pack-bold and fever-lean, coursing warmth across the flats.

monsters.name: Glass-hare
monsters.lore: Razor-swift over the fulgurite, kicking up glass-dust.

monsters.name: Ash salamander
monsters.lore: Ember-veined, it beds in warm ash and lashes with a scalding tail.

monsters.name: Cinder vulture
monsters.lore: Huge and ash-caked, it stoops on anything that slows.

monsters.name: Dune adder
monsters.lore: Fever-fast, it strikes from under the ash at a footfall.

monsters.name: Dune ogre
monsters.lore: Waste-born and collared, set to hold the one deep spring against the nomads it once shared water with.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A night signal-heath — miles of humming aether-pylons flickering against the dark, their knife-edged shadows sliding across the heather until the whole moor strobes. Every light out there says come here. None of them means safety.

monsters.name: Glare vole
monsters.lore: It came to the beacons for warmth. Plate-broad and blinding-pale now, it smothers lamps.

monsters.name: Bog-cotton hare
monsters.lore: Strobe-maddened, bolting in blind zigzags.

monsters.name: Night-shrew
monsters.lore: Over-large now, lunging silent out of the strobe.

monsters.name: Shadow-line wolf
monsters.lore: It hunts inside the moving shadows, unseen until it crosses a light.

monsters.name: Pylon adder
monsters.lore: Charged and fever-bold, striking from the cable-runs.

monsters.name: Flicker-wight
monsters.lore: A keeper electrocuted at a junction, aether caught in the arc. It exists only between flashes.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A great muster-meadow drowned in banners — the field where Men gathered their armies, cut off mid-muster, a hundred standards rotting on their poles. The banners hang colorless in the dead air. They crowned a goblin to guard it. They know you're coming.

monsters.name: Goblin guard
monsters.lore: Goblins have no business on a muster-meadow of Men. Gnarl's honor-watch was posted here as mockery doubled, and knows it.

monsters.name: Banner-broken wolf
monsters.lore: Tangled in dragging colors, it hunts the tent-lanes.

monsters.name: Courier-hound
monsters.lore: It runs its dead routes forever, savaging what it finds on them.

monsters.name: Parade-horse
monsters.lore: Riderless and fever-wild, it tramples the churned field.

monsters.name: Banner-kite
monsters.lore: Nesting in the standards, it stoops on anything bright.

monsters.name: Muster-wight
monsters.lore: The field's dead, aether pooled in the trampled mire. A rank that forms and marches nowhere.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The meadows end against mountain-root bolted to the tower's ribs. A mine mouth breathes cold air and rust-red water, and the dwarf lamps over the adit still burn, tended by nobody. Small clawed tracks stitch every path going in.

monsters.name: Kobold scavenger
monsters.lore: It has survived every collapse this mine has offered by being the first thing out. The pry-bar is for slower questions.

monsters.name: Rust hound
monsters.lore: Bred to run down thieves in the galleries. The rust never reached the part that wants your heels.

monsters.name: Red Orc outrider
monsters.lore: Half a warframe still turns half the blows. The ledger it keeps is short on mercy.

monsters.name: Adit bat
monsters.lore: It roosts in the lamp-warmth over the mine mouth and takes its meals off whatever the lamps draw in.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The dwarves drowned this mine on purpose, to stop what was digging up at them. When the tower took it, the pumps came back on halfway. Now the galleries stand waist-deep and black, and the water is never quite still.

monsters.name: Bilge kobold
monsters.lore: It poles the flooded galleries by lamp-hiss and habit. Climbers float face down eventually; it just keeps the schedule.

monsters.name: Drowned hauler
monsters.lore: Dwarf-plate seized over six legs of ore-cart iron. Slow as the flood and about as easy to argue with.

monsters.name: Red Orc salvage-diver
monsters.lore: A sealed warframe keeps the water out and some of the steel in. Salvage pays; you pay better.

monsters.name: Sump eel
monsters.lore: It came up the pump-lines when the water came back, and it has been growing ever since.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Every ounce that left the mines was weighed here, in halls of brass and slate. The tally-engines still run on habit, counting shipments that stopped coming years ago. Kobolds have learned to read just enough to argue with them.

monsters.name: Kobold coin-sifter
monsters.lore: It cannot read the scrip it hoards, but it knows exactly what a hand reaching for the pile means.

monsters.name: Haywire tally-engine
monsters.lore: Brass casing, broken arithmetic. It has been counting to the same wrong number for years.

monsters.name: Red Orc debt-collector
monsters.lore: The warband taxes everything that walks this floor. The plate is company property; the enthusiasm is its own.

monsters.name: Ledger wisp
monsters.lore: The Counting Halls remember every unpaid ounce. Some of that memory has come loose and drifts.

monsters.name: Scrip rat
monsters.lore: It nests in worthless money and defends it like treasure, which on this floor passes for wisdom.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Whole halls of gearing, floor to unseen ceiling, that once turned the mines' lifts and hammers. Half of it still creeps, tooth by tooth, fed by some deep spring nobody has found and shut off. The sound gets into your back teeth.

monsters.name: Kobold gear-thief
monsters.lore: It strips cogs the way other things strip carcasses — patiently, from the edges in, wrench-first.

monsters.name: Runaway flywheel
monsters.lore: A millstone of drive-iron that shook off its axle years ago. It only knows one direction at a time.

monsters.name: Red Orc pit-fighter
monsters.lore: Chalk ring, house rules, no plate above the waist. It wins bets here, and you are the odds.

monsters.name: Belt-runner
monsters.lore: Something marten-quick lives on the drive belts and has never once touched the floor.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The heart of dwarf-country: vaults where they split atoms the way their grandfathers split stone. The great cores still glow behind yard-thick doors, and the light through the seams is the only dawn this floor gets.

monsters.name: Glow-sick kobold
monsters.lore: The vault-light got into it years back. Fear burned away first, and spells find little left to grip.

monsters.name: Red Orc fuel-thief
monsters.lore: Two runs a night, lead pannier full, and every climber met is time lost. It has no plans to lose time politely.

monsters.name: Forge remnant
monsters.lore: A vault-tender in dwarf-plate, headless and thorough. The checklist is gone; the round continues.

monsters.name: Rod-wisp
monsters.lore: Light that leaked from a cracked core and learned the shape of a lantern-bearer. Spells pass through it like more light.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A hundred family forges around one great communal anvil, the way dwarves have always worked: alone, together. The plasma feeds still run hot. The Red Orcs use the Commons now, and what they make is cruder and works fine.

monsters.name: Red Orc armorer
monsters.lore: It hammers warframes for the warband and wears its best work to the job. Trade-ins accepted, forcibly.

monsters.name: Kobold hammer-carrier
monsters.lore: Apprenticed by habit to whoever holds the forge. The hammer is twice its height; it has learned exactly one swing.

monsters.name: Half-forged thing
monsters.lore: Left on the great anvil mid-making, it finished itself. One side is still cooling; the temper never set right.

monsters.name: Bellows hound
monsters.lore: Forge-hounds were bred to run messages between family fires. The families are gone; the running is not.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The great smelters have not been fired in years, but the slag-runs never cooled all the way. Heat shimmers over black glass channels, and the ladles hang overhead like church bells nobody dares ring.

monsters.name: Slag rat
monsters.lore: Generations in the warm dark under the ladles made it big, and none of them made it timid.

monsters.name: Kobold ladle-crew
monsters.lore: Three kobolds, one crank, and a firm belief that whatever the ladle lands on had it coming.

monsters.name: Red Orc smelter-boss
monsters.lore: Quota is short and the plate is thick with spatter no chisel will shift. Everything here is salvage to it, you included.

monsters.name: Heat-haunt
monsters.lore: The shimmer over the slag-runs sometimes stands up and walks. The old smelter crews would not work alone.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Below the halls, below the vaults, the drifts where the dwarves dug last and quietest. The winch-ropes still hang down the shafts, taut under loads nobody signed for. Lamps are scarce here, and the dark has had years to settle in.

monsters.name: Blind kobold digger
monsters.lore: Wax-pale and eyeless three generations down. In the dark you are the one at the disadvantage, and it knows it.

monsters.name: Winch-crawler
monsters.lore: A winch head climbing on its own cable, hand over iron hand. It has never hurried and never let go.

monsters.name: Pit hound
monsters.lore: The deep shafts bred the rust hounds longer and quieter. By the time you hear it, it has counted your paces.

monsters.name: Drift moth
monsters.lore: It feeds on lamp-oil and dust, and it likes its meals lit. Miners learned to work dark for a reason.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: This is where the dwarves made their stand: vault doors a yard thick, blown off their hinges and lying where they fell. The scorch-marks climb three stories. Nobody has moved the doors. Nobody could.

monsters.name: Red Orc door-breaker
monsters.lore: It was in the breach when the doors came down, and the warframe still carries the dwarf-fire scars. It is owed, it feels.

monsters.name: Kobold powder-boy
monsters.lore: A keg under each arm and a fuse for a scarf. It has outlived every crew it ever served, which should worry the crews.

monsters.name: Doorward remnant
monsters.lore: One door-engine survived the breach and never accepted it. It cannot be argued past — only outlasted.

monsters.name: Breach crow
monsters.lore: It followed the Red Orcs up-tower the way crows have always followed armies. The breach was the best day of its life.

monsters.name: Scorch rat
monsters.lore: The breach cooked everything in the hall but the rats, and the rats took notes.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The last hall before the lift is a warcamp now — cookfires in ore carts, warframes racked like cordwood, the Red Orcs' banner hung from the dwarves' own crane. Drums somewhere deeper keep a slow time. They are not for you. They are for him.

monsters.name: Red Orc honor guard
monsters.lore: Skarn's own, in plate polished to a dull red shine. The posting cost them blood, and they intend it to cost you more.

monsters.name: Warframe champion
monsters.lore: It fought up from the gear galleries pit by pit for the honor of meeting you first. The salvaged frame fits like a reputation.

monsters.name: Warcamp hound
monsters.lore: Short chain, shorter rations, and it slipped both. The camp is betting on the hound.

monsters.name: Drum kobold
monsters.lore: It keeps the warcamp's slow time. The drums are not for you — but a dropped beat brings the whole camp's eyes.

monsters.name: Camp looter
monsters.lore: Every army drags a tail of things that fight for the leavings. This one has done well by the Red Orcs.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The mine air gives way to marsh air, which is not an improvement. Drowned fields run to a grey horizon under a lid of fog, studded with burial cairns older than any war you have heard of. The mud holds footprints going in. Fewer coming out.

monsters.name: Mire ghoul
monsters.lore: It has eaten better since the tower came than its whole line ate before it. It sees no reason the run should end.

monsters.name: Bog hound
monsters.lore: It died loyal to somebody on the old towpath. What runs it now keeps the route and lost the loyalty.

monsters.name: Cairn-light
monsters.lore: The locals had one rule about the cairn-lights: never follow. Nobody made a rule for when the light follows you.

monsters.name: Mire leech
monsters.lore: The drowned fields feed everything slowly except the leeches, which have never once been patient.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Rows of low barrows with toppled offering-posts, where the marsh folk once paid their dead in bread and tin. The tower tore the land up with the graves still in it, and the dead noticed. The offering-bowls have been licked clean.

monsters.name: Tithe-wight
monsters.lore: The custom is older than the priest: the dead are owed bread and tin. The bowl has been empty a long time.

monsters.name: Barrow ghoul
monsters.lore: It dug clean through a king's barrow and came out proud, wearing his torc. Rank, among ghouls, is worn on the forearm.

monsters.name: Grave beetle
monsters.lore: The old dead fed a whole economy under the turf. Its shell is the marsh's answer to a shield wall.

monsters.name: Barrow rat
monsters.lore: It lives on offerings and offal, and it has learned that climbers carry both.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The elves' stolen forest, sunk hip-deep in the marsh it was welded to. The bio-lights that once lit the deep woods hang dark on every bough, like a city with the power cut. Older elves in Roothollow will not say what walks here. You are about to find out.

monsters.name: Pale stag
monsters.lore: The elves bred it to carry the forest light through the deep woods. It remembers the weight of it, and hates you fresh.

monsters.name: Glade-wight
monsters.lore: She stayed when the lights died, and the garden kept her. Spells slide off what is left like rain off wax leaves.

monsters.name: Lamp-eater
monsters.lore: It cracks the dead bio-lamps for the marrow of light inside, and its belly glows faint through the skin.

monsters.name: Lamp moth
monsters.lore: When the bio-lights went dark the moths did not leave. They just got hungrier about what light remains.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A war was fought over this marsh once, by soldiers in exo-rigs built to keep them dry. The rigs are still here, rusted to the hips in bog water, and the marsh has been patiently finishing what the war started. Some of the rigs still stand watch.

monsters.name: Rig-wight
monsters.lore: The soldier is dead these many years and still on duty. The rig keeps the watch; the salute is muscle memory.

monsters.name: Rig-stripper ghoul
monsters.lore: Years of opening exo-rigs like oysters capped its knuckles with salvaged plate. Your armor reads as shell.

monsters.name: Drowned beacon
monsters.lore: The beacon still blinks under a foot of bog water. The thing beside it learned that light draws rescuers.

monsters.name: Marsh adder
monsters.lore: It dens in a flooded rig's chest cavity, which tells you everything about the neighborhood.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A raised stone road runs arrow-straight through the marsh, built for funerals and nothing else. Every slab is a name. The processions stopped when the tower came, but the road remembers its purpose, and things line the verges waiting for the next one.

monsters.name: Procession-wight
monsters.lore: It has led ten thousand funerals and been short one mourner for a century. Grief that old stops taking no.

monsters.name: Verge ghoul
monsters.lore: Funerals mean fresh graves; the road taught it that generations ago. It keeps polite funeral distance until it doesn't.

monsters.name: Passing-bell light
monsters.lore: It rings a passing-bell for the about-to-die. It is rarely wrong, and it is ringing now.

monsters.name: Coffin-bearer
monsters.lore: Two bearers fused to one iron-bound coffin, still walking the route. Nobody has looked inside and reported back.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Generations of marsh folk cut fuel here, and the cuts run like black canals to the fog line. Peat keeps what it takes — the diggers used to find old kings in the banks, leather-brown and sleeping. The tower's theft shook the banks loose. The kings are up.

monsters.name: Peat-cured king
monsters.lore: A thousand years in the peat tanned him tough as boat leather. Every wound closes with a wet brown sound — outlast him if you can.

monsters.name: Cutter ghoul
monsters.lore: It works the banks with a peat-cutter's blade and a harvester's patience. You are standing on its next cut.

monsters.name: Turf hound
monsters.lore: Packed peat and root in the shape of loyalty. Thrown stones just improve it.

monsters.name: Midge cloud
monsters.lore: Marsh midges in a swarm dense enough to have opinions. The cuts breed them by the ton.

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

floors.description: Walled yards where the marsh folk laid out their dead for the birds, as their custom asked. The walls still stand, the gates still latch, and the yards are still in use — but nothing has flown over this floor in years, and the dead are not being taken up.

monsters.name: Garth-keeper
monsters.lore: Little more than vestments and wind, still making its rounds. The fines are old law, and old law does not haggle.

monsters.name: Yard ghoul
monsters.lore: With the birds gone the ghouls took over the sky-burial work. This one is lean, fast, and behind on quota.

monsters.name: Restless heap
monsters.lore: The laid-out dead grew tired of waiting for a sky that never comes. Together they are patient, and slow, and many.

monsters.name: Picker rat
monsters.lore: The rats do the birds' old work now, badly. The garths have never been so crowded.

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A chantry to the old river gods, taken with the marsh and settling ever since — nave flooded to the pews, tower leaning like a man asleep on his feet. The bells still ring the hours. Nobody winds them. The hours they ring are wrong.

monsters.name: Chantry cantor
monsters.lore: It keeps the offices in a voice like water in a crypt. The old river gods may even still be listening.

monsters.name: Font ghoul
monsters.lore: It claimed sanctuary in the great font years ago. Sanctuary, it has decided, does not extend to visitors.

monsters.name: Vigil light
monsters.lore: A votive flame that outlived its brass boat. Each pew it passes, something under the water sits up.

monsters.name: Drowned congregant
monsters.lore: The congregation never left the pews when the nave flooded. Attendance, in fact, has improved.

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

floors.description: The moor before the Kingsbarrow is set with standing stones, each one a sealed door in the old tongue. The marsh folk raised them to keep something in, and maintained them for a thousand years. Maintenance has lapsed. Some of the doors stand ajar.

monsters.name: Doorstone warder
monsters.lore: Set at its stone a thousand years ago to challenge whatever comes off the moor. The mail rusted; the orders didn't.

monsters.name: Moor ghoul
monsters.lore: This far in, the ghouls are old and careful and fat on what leaks through the doors. It can afford to wait.

monsters.name: Something unsealed
monsters.lore: The old folk went to real trouble sealing it. It is half out of the world still, and spells reach only the half that isn't here.

monsters.name: Moor hound
monsters.lore: It courses the stone rows at night. What it was bred to keep in, it now keeps company.

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: One barrow the size of a hill, ringed by a moat of black water and a century of tribute — swords, crowns, exo-rigs, all sinking slow. Every dead thing on this floor answers to what sleeps here, and the ground over it rises and falls like something breathing.

monsters.name: Herald of the barrow
monsters.lore: It announces you to the barrow in a note you feel in your fillings, which is worse than an ambush.

monsters.name: Tribute-bearer
monsters.lore: Dropping the offering would shame it before the King. It sets the body down carefully, first.

monsters.name: Kingsbarrow guard
monsters.lore: Buried in their mail, buried with their rigs. Rust and bone move as one thing, and the plate remembers its trade.

monsters.name: Moat watcher
monsters.lore: A century of tribute sank into the black moat, and something grew fond of the collection.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The marsh fog ends at a cave mouth, and the cave mouth ends the light. Beyond the gate town's lamps the dark is total, older than the tower, and strung corner to corner with silk. The first rule of the Webdeep is written over the gate: touch nothing that hums.

monsters.name: Cave broodling
monsters.lore: It has a thousand siblings audible above, and every one of them learned to drop before it learned to walk.

monsters.name: Silk-wrapped husk
monsters.lore: The struggling cocoon is the lure. The floor under it is not floor, and it has all day.

monsters.name: Grave-moth
monsters.lore: Harmless itself — but what hunts by the dust it sheds is not, and the moth knows exactly whom to lead it to.

monsters.name: Threshold beetle
monsters.lore: It cleans the webs of whatever the spiders leave, and it has stopped waiting for them to finish.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The tower's veins run through this cavern — cables thick as oaks, branching down into the dark, carrying power to the floors above. Everything here lives off the leakage. The spiders' webs are woven copper-and-silk, and they carry a charge.

monsters.name: Wire-weaver
monsters.lore: Its web is half copper and carries a charge. The flies die before they finish landing; climbers take a moment longer.

monsters.name: Cable troll
monsters.lore: It wears a chewed trunk cable like a stole, and the leakage has done things to its temper the dark never managed.

monsters.name: Jittering husk
monsters.lore: It twitches in time with the current that keeps it. Cut the web and it just twitches toward you instead.

monsters.name: Charge-wisp
monsters.lore: Leakage that pooled long enough to want things. Spells feed it more than they hurt it.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Warrens dug tight as honeycomb, every wall padded white with brood silk. The air is warm here, the only warm air in the Webdeep, and it smells of milk and vinegar. Things hatch in the walls as you pass. Try not to take it personally.

monsters.name: Broodling swarm
monsters.lore: Forty small spiders with one opinion. They have never once been individually.

monsters.name: Warren troll
monsters.lore: Silk-blinded and kept as a nursery guard, fed just enough. It fills the tunnel wall to wall — you will not go around it, only through.

monsters.name: Brood-midwife
monsters.lore: It turns each egg-sac with terrible gentleness, and it put itself between you and the clutch before you decided anything.

monsters.name: Warren bat
monsters.lore: It nests in the one warm cavern of the Webdeep and pays rent in whatever it knocks from the air.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Before the spiders, trolls dug here — crude, enormous galleries shouldered out of raw stone, ceilings lost to your lamp. The trolls are still digging. Nobody knows toward what, and the one time a climber asked, the answer took a week to bury.

monsters.name: Delving troll
monsters.lore: You are standing on its spoil-heap. This is, by troll law, the whole of the case against you.

monsters.name: Troll whelp
monsters.lore: It has just learned that soft things dig easier, and you are the softest thing it has seen all week.

monsters.name: Gallery stalker
monsters.lore: It follows the troll digs the way gulls follow a plow, and it keeps to the ceiling seam, patient as arithmetic.

monsters.name: Rubble borer
monsters.lore: A chitin engine the trolls' digging woke. It eats stone; everything else it bores through on principle.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The caverns here are stacked with the tower's thinking-engines, racks of them running down into the dark, warm to the touch and muttering. The spiders web the aisles for the heat. Whatever the engines are computing, they have been at it since the theft.

monsters.name: Rack-weaver
monsters.lore: It webbed a whole engine-rack into its nest and grew strange on the warmth. Its eyes reflect your lamp in rows, like little status lights.

monsters.name: Signal husk
monsters.lore: The engines have been using it. It walks with a purpose nothing dead should have, and spells blur against whatever is being computed inside.

monsters.name: Heat-drunk troll
monsters.lore: It sleeps pressed to the warmest rack like a cat against a stove. Your footstep landed wrong.

monsters.name: Aisle-runner
monsters.lore: Bred lean by generations of hunting the warm aisles. The racks light up as it passes, row by row.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A city hangs over the chasm, built entirely of silk — streets, towers, bridges, swaying in air that does not move. Something lived in it before the spiders; the shape of the doorways says so. The doorways are the wrong shape for spiders too.

monsters.name: Bridge-weaver
monsters.lore: It is not repairing the bridge you are standing on. It is adjusting the load rating.

monsters.name: Citizen husk
monsters.lore: Arranged at a silk window with care, one arm raised. As you pass, the arm finishes the gesture.

monsters.name: Chasm troll
monsters.lore: Too heavy for any street, it climbs the city's underside, tearing handholds in other people's architecture.

monsters.name: Silk drifter
monsters.lore: It balloons between the silk towers on threads of its own casting, and it boards passing climbers like cargo.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A cavern floor flat as a threshing yard, which should have been the first warning. Every few paces a hinge of silk, dusted to match the stone. The locals walk this floor like it is checkered, and only step on white.

monsters.name: Trapdoor spider
monsters.lore: Mostly forelegs, faster than an apology. The hole it drags toward is exactly your size.

monsters.name: Sprung trap
monsters.lore: A trap that fired and lost, still fighting the fight it remembers. It gets up when you edge past.

monsters.name: Field-wise troll
monsters.lore: It crosses the fields by memory, sure as a dancer, and it does not like sharing the route map.

monsters.name: Dust moth
monsters.lore: It powders the trapdoor lids to match the stone. The spiders tolerate it the way farmers tolerate crows.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The spiders store their wealth here: vault after vault of wrapped shapes, hung in rows by size, catalogued by scent. Some bundles are provisions. Some are prisoners. The economy of the Webdeep does not distinguish, and the vault-keepers resent an audit.

monsters.name: Vault-keeper
monsters.lore: It counts by touch, bundle by bundle. You are unlabeled, unwrapped, unaccounted for — an error it was made to correct.

monsters.name: Fresh bundle
monsters.lore: Still warm and very determined. One arm free, one knife, and no questions left about how to use either.

monsters.name: Vault-breaker troll
monsters.lore: It came in the honest way, through the wall, and it eats down the rows like a man at a market stall. It will take a while to stop.

monsters.name: Vault rat
monsters.lore: A vault of catalogued provisions is, from a rat's side of the ledger, simply a granary with opinions.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The approach to the Broodthrone runs through galleries of eggs, each sac tall as a door and lit faintly from inside. The light moves. The locals call this floor the nursery and will not say it above a whisper — everything here is Vyx's, and Vyx counts.

monsters.name: Gallery sentinel
monsters.lore: The spiders here do not hunt; they garrison. The challenge phrase is real, and there is no right answer.

monsters.name: Hatching sac
monsters.lore: Newborn and knee-high, it knows the two facts of its life: it is hungry, and you are near.

monsters.name: Brood-fed troll
monsters.lore: Paid for guard duty in whatever fails inspection. It takes the work seriously; the work is you.

monsters.name: Sac-light
monsters.lore: The glow that moves inside the eggs sometimes moves outside them. Vyx counts those too.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The heart of the Webdeep is one vast chamber, and the chamber is a web, and the web is a throne room. Every thread in the Deep ends here. The dark overhead is not empty — it is occupied, and it has been reading your footsteps since floor thirty-one.

monsters.name: Throne-web guard
monsters.lore: Bred big and patient, holding the throne's own anchor-lines. It lets you see it coming — the lesson is the point.

monsters.name: Wrapped knight
monsters.lore: A climber in good plate got this far once. The armor still works fine; the man inside works for Vyx now.

monsters.name: Pale consort
monsters.lore: It has outlived every rival by being exactly this careful, and it is faster than careful looks.

monsters.name: Thread-page
monsters.lore: It runs messages along the throne-lines. What it reports, the whole chamber hears.

monsters.name: Tribute husk
monsters.lore: The Deep sends its rent up to the throne walking. Interfering with the post is taken poorly.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: You come up out of the dark into heat like a hand on your face. Ash desert runs flat to a shimmering horizon, grey over the buried slag of some reactor the tower broke in the taking. The locals paint their roofs white, and their deep wells still come up warm.

monsters.name: Ash salamander
monsters.lore: It swims the ash the way fish swim water, and heat rolls off it in welcome. Fire is where it lives; spells of it are a compliment.

monsters.name: Dune ogre
monsters.lore: Skin baked to crockery, patience baked harder. Your water skin became community property on sight.

monsters.name: Cinder vulture
monsters.lore: It roosts on the warm vents and has gone strange with it. A polite landing distance, out here, is a diagnosis.

monsters.name: Ashline jackal
monsters.lore: It works the line between the wells and the waste, living off what turns back too late.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Something burned hot enough here to turn a mile of desert to glass. The flats are black and smooth and sing underfoot, crazed with cracks that catch the light wrong. The locals cross at dawn, when the glass is quiet. It is not dawn.

monsters.name: Glass salamander
monsters.lore: It suns itself under a yard of black glass like a fish under ice. The fresh cracks are how it says it has seen you.

monsters.name: Shard-picker ogre
monsters.lore: Its hands are past scarring and its hide has gone the way of its hands. Setting the hammer down is not an improvement.

monsters.name: Heat-ghost
monsters.lore: The heat makes shapes, and this one stopped obeying the wind. Spells warp around it like more heat.

monsters.name: Flat-skitter
monsters.lore: A lizard that hunts on the singing glass, faster than the cracks it causes.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The reactor's spoil was dumped here in ridges, and the ridges never quite cooled. Slag country: black hills that tick as they settle, seams of dull red glowing in the cuts, air that tastes of struck matches. Things den in the warm hills. Big things.

monsters.name: Slag salamander
monsters.lore: Denned in a red seam, fat on the heat, scales gone the color of cooling iron. Annoyed is most of the way to violence.

monsters.name: Ridge ogre
monsters.lore: It struck a good seam and claimed the hill with one bellow. The claim, as it understands things, includes you.

monsters.name: Clinker hound
monsters.lore: It cools as it comes, and by arrival it is hard as a bell. It knows this. It is not hurrying.

monsters.name: Cinder bat
monsters.lore: It dens in the warm hills with everything else big enough to matter, and hunts the ridge roads by heat.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The buried reactor breathes through this desert — vents tall as chimneys, exhaling steam and ash on a schedule the locals set their clocks by. Between eruptions the country is almost peaceful. Check the schedule.

monsters.name: Vent salamander
monsters.lore: It rides the vent-blasts for sport and lands loose and easy, the way of an animal that has never once been cold.

monsters.name: Scalded ogre
monsters.lore: A vent caught it, bright pink down one side and in a mood. Somebody is to blame, and you are available.

monsters.name: Ash wyrmling
monsters.lore: A long way from the Cindermouth nest, wings still wet — exactly as dangerous as a lost child with a furnace in it.

monsters.name: Vent crab
monsters.lore: It grew its shell against the eruption schedule. Nothing on that schedule was ever in a hurry.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The ogres terraced this slope generations ago, hauling slag blocks into steps a giant could climb, and they farm heat here — kilns on every terrace, each clan's fire banked and never let die. Strangers on the Steps are fuel until proven otherwise.

monsters.name: Terrace ogre
monsters.lore: The terrace is its charge and the kiln is its clock. It does not tire, it does not move fast, and it does not need to — the fire does the waiting.

monsters.name: Kiln salamander
monsters.lore: Somebody's prize mouser, collared in copper, sleek with heat, and off its rope. Spells break on it like spray on a kiln door.

monsters.name: Kiln vulture
monsters.lore: It is working out why the fire died and whether the answer is edible. Its head keeps you in view all the way around.

monsters.name: Kiln goat
monsters.lore: The clans keep goats on the terraces for milk and temper. Mostly temper.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Wind-built dunes of ash and cinder, still holding last year's heat a hand's depth down. At night the dune faces glow in long slow bands, and the whole desert breathes orange. It is beautiful. Almost everything beautiful out here is a mouth.

monsters.name: Dune-swimmer salamander
monsters.lore: The wake comes first, quick as a skipped stone. The breach comes last, jaws open, gloriously happy.

monsters.name: Ember-blind ogre
monsters.lore: Blind from staring into too many years of ember-glow. It navigates by smell now, and it has found yours.

monsters.name: Ember moths
monsters.lore: Each one carries a live cinder in its belly, drawn to anything warmer than the desert. You qualify.

monsters.name: Dune adder
monsters.lore: It hunts the glowing dune faces at night, striking at whatever blocks the light.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: Here the reactor comes up for air: a canyon torn open in the taking, walls of fused ash, and at the bottom the machine itself — cracked, half-alive, shedding a light with no color you can name. The locals will sell you lead-lined cloaks. Buy one.

monsters.name: Scar-born salamander
monsters.lore: The canyon nests come out changed — translucent, bright inside, wrong in the joints. Its shadow runs a half-second behind.

monsters.name: Canyon hermit
monsters.lore: Cloaked head to foot in hammered lead sheeting. It has stayed alive by tolerating no visitors, and its record is unbroken.

monsters.name: Colorless flame
monsters.lore: A flame with no color and no fuel, casting shadows in the wrong directions. Spells go into it and do not come out.

monsters.name: Scar rat
monsters.lore: Everything in the canyon is a little wrong, and the rats are wrong in the direction of bigger.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A forest stood here when the realm was taken, and it burned standing. The trunks remain — miles of black pillars, branchless, holding up nothing.   When the wind moves through, they sound a low note like a pipe organ with one key held down.

monsters.name: Charcoal salamander
monsters.lore: It hunts by holding still against the trunks and being, briefly, the wrong tree.

monsters.name: Rooter ogre
monsters.lore: It rips stumps with no rope and no wedge, only opinion. The opinion transfers.

monsters.name: Hollow trunk
monsters.lore: It has stood in the row long enough to fool the birds. Burned wood does not hurry, and does not bruise.

monsters.name: Soot owl
monsters.lore: It nests in the hollow trunks and hunts the organ-note wind. Silent, except for the forest holding its breath.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The last stretch before the Cindermouth is a highway melted by use — a channel of glassed ash, polished by the belly of something that commutes.   Shed scales the size of doors lean against the banks, still warm. The locals harvest them on the quiet days.

monsters.name: Road wyrmling
monsters.lore: It practices its glide down the melted channel. It bowls into you more than it attacks you, but it weighs what a boat weighs, and it is teething.

monsters.name: Scale-picker ogre
monsters.lore: The scale trade made it rich by ogre standards, and it wears its stock — shed wyrm-plate lapped like roof tiles. Rich things hire fewer witnesses.

monsters.name: Molt-fat salamander
monsters.lore: Glutted on shed skin: gleaming, slow — right up until it is none of those things.

monsters.name: Glass hare
monsters.lore: It runs the polished channel for the speed of it, and it has learned to use climbers as corner-posts.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The center of the Scorch is a caldera of fused ash, and the caldera is a nest. Half-melted tribute rings the rim — armor, wagons, a gate town that stood too close. The heat rises in slow beats, like a pulse. Halfway up the tower, and the tower keeps a dragon.

monsters.name: Nest wyrmling
monsters.lore: The runt of the nest, barge-sized, with a runt's temper about visitors. The word runt is doing heavy work.

monsters.name: Tribute ogre
monsters.lore: The clan hauls tribute to keep the wyrm off their terraces. The wagon shed a wheel; you are lighter than the wagon.

monsters.name: Caldera salamander
monsters.lore: In the nest's shadow they grow to the size of oxen and fear nothing that walks. The turning is the whole announcement.

monsters.name: Rim jackal
monsters.lore: It works the tribute-road for what falls off the wagons, and climbers count as falling off.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The heat of the Scorch dies in a single doorway. Frosthold opens onto a valley of blue ice under a sunless glare, boulder-fields raked into walls by a glacier with somewhere to be. The cold is not weather. It is policy — the Jarl's, and it is enforced.

monsters.name: Rime wolf
monsters.lore: It has run down warmer things than you and eaten them mid-stride. The frost coat is from never slowing.

monsters.name: Moraine troll
monsters.lore: Being a boulder is a toll practice older than the tower, and it has never lost this game.

monsters.name: Frozen scout
monsters.lore: One of last winter's climbers, ice to the bone. The cold in it drinks spellwork like it drank the man.

monsters.name: Glare hawk
monsters.lore: It hunts down-sun of the sunless glare, and it has learned that climbers look up too late.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: The tower's coolant was pumped through this realm once, a sea of it, and when the pumps died the sea froze mid-swell. Waves stand overhead in green-white glass.   The locals cut roads through the crests and post the ice depth at every bend, in fresh paint.

monsters.name: Floe wolf pack-leader
monsters.lore: It hunts by ear, through the ice, from below. The pack above is only there to steer you.

monsters.name: Swell troll
monsters.lore: It hangs in the green glass of its wave like a fly in amber, wearing the sea itself for plate.

monsters.name: Coolant wight
monsters.lore: It drowned before the sea froze and walks under the ice, upside down. Spells refract somewhere on the way through.

monsters.name: Brine gull
monsters.lore: It works the frozen swells for whatever the wolves leave, and it has stopped waiting for the wolves.

runt.tag: gaunt and limping — an easy kill, thin pickings

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay

alpha.tag: an alpha, twice the size — worth a fortune or a funeral

floors.description: A pine forest sealed in clear ice, every needle cased in glass. When the wind comes down off the glacier the whole forest rings, a million small bells with no church. The Jarl's folk log it with hammers. What lives in it prefers the quiet, and enforces it.

monsters.name: Glass-antlered stag
monsters.lore: Its antlers are solid ice, grown that way, points refreshed nightly. It has stopped running from things — the antlers are why.

monsters.name: Hammer-logger troll
monsters.lore: It logs the frozen pines with a maul and gang-rules it ate. Your footsteps ring the forest like an alarm.

monsters.name: Bell-wise wolf
monsters.lore: It learned to walk without ringing the trees, and it made the wolf soft-footed beyond nature. The first you hear is its weight arriving.

monsters.name: Chime sprite
monsters.lore: When the forest rings, something in the ringing answers. It prefers the quiet, and enforces it.

tough.tag: scarred and heavy-set — dangerous, but it will pay
